+title: Add the source allowlist and blocklist, checked before any I/O
+---
+## What
+
+marketplace.md §6.7 and §10 item 2. A managed host must be able to limit which marketplaces load. The check runs before any network or disk access.
+
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/Marketplace/SourcePattern.swift`: `public enum SourcePattern: Sendable, Hashable, Codable` with `.exact(String)` (a normalized URL), `.owner(host: String, owner: String)` (for example `github.com` and `swissarmyhammer`; matches every repository of that owner over SSH or HTTPS, and the `github:` shorthand), `.hostRegex(String)`, and `.pathPrefix(String)` (for `file://` sources). Match on `MarketplaceLocation.normalizedURL`.
+- `MarketplacePolicy`: `allowedSources: [SourcePattern]?` (default `nil` = allow all) and `blockedSources: [SourcePattern]` (default empty). An empty `allowedSources` array blocks every source. The blocklist wins over the allowlist.
+- `MarketplaceStore`: evaluate the policy for each source in `init`. A refused source gets a diagnostic, gets no layer, and is never passed to `GitTransport`, `MarketplaceCache`, or the file system. This applies to `start()`, `check()`, `update()`, and the seed folder.
+
+- [ ] `SourcePattern` and its matching
+- [ ] The policy fields and the allow/block rule
+- [ ] Enforcement in `MarketplaceStore` before any I/O
+- [ ] Tests
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A blocked source makes zero transport calls and has no layer, and the store records a diagnostic that names the source and the pattern
+- [ ] `allowedSources: []` refuses every source
+- [ ] An owner pattern matches the SSH, HTTPS, and `github:` forms of the same repository
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/SourcePatternTests.swift`: a table of URLs against each pattern kind, including SSH/HTTPS/`github:` forms and a `file://` path prefix
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/MarketplacePolicyTests.swift` with the counting transport double: blocked source (zero calls, no layer, a diagnostic); empty allowlist; blocklist wins over allowlist; an allowed source still syncs
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter "SourcePatternTests|MarketplacePolicyTests"`; then `swift test`; all green
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file

     - The seed folder of the card is not in the code yet. Task 01M2H1P68DQAVE9B0SAC5HEFA3 adds `file://` sources and the seed folder. That task must send its sources through the same `Preparation` gate.
   timestamp: 2026-09-15T20:20:50.282828+00:00
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m2kbpbry0asczj1547sea1cf
+  text: |-
+    Implementation landed. TDD order: both test files first, then a build that failed with "cannot find 'SourcePattern' in scope", then the code.
+
+    What the code does now.
+
+    - `SourcePattern` is a public `Sendable, Hashable, Codable` enum with `.exact`, `.owner(host:owner:)`, `.hostRegex`, and `.pathPrefix`. `matches(normalizedURL:)` is internal and pure: it reads no file and opens no connection. It splits the normalized URL into a host and a path, thus one owner pattern reaches the SSH form, the HTTPS form, and the `github:` shorthand of the same repository. A host regex must match the whole host; a regex that does not compile matches nothing. A path prefix compares whole path components, thus `/opt/skills` does not match `/opt/skills-other`. `CustomStringConvertible` gives the text that a diagnostic shows.
+    - `MarketplacePolicy` has `allowedSources: [SourcePattern]?` and `blockedSources: [SourcePattern]`, plus the internal `refusal(forNormalizedURL:)` and the internal `SourceRefusal` enum. The blocklist wins. An empty allowlist refuses every source.
+    - `Preparation.add(source:)` runs the policy right after the pure URL parse and before it makes a `MarketplaceCache`. A refused source gets one error diagnostic that names the source and the pattern, and it never becomes a `PreparedSource`.
+
+    One test error to remember: `"abc".contains("")` is `false` in Swift. The first run of `anEmptyAllowlistRefusesEverySource` failed because the test helper asked the message to contain an empty pattern text. The helper now skips the pattern check when there is no one pattern.
+
+    Test evidence: `swift test --filter "SourcePatternTests|MarketplacePolicyTests"` — 10 tests in 2 suites, all pass. `swift test` — 650 tests in 49 suites, all pass, zero warnings.
+  timestamp: 2026-09-15T20:21:20.286195+00:00

 - 01M2H125CCEZMT2PZAW6DRYE1R
